root_cause: Generic Composio LinkedIn managed-auth links produced healthy personal member connections but did not request organization-admin/write scopes. Reauthorizing the same generic config therefore could never satisfy the canonical company provider preflight.
prevention_rule: Company recovery must create or reuse an auth config that explicitly requests r_organization_admin and w_organization_social, bind verification to the exact newly created connected account, prove the canonical organization through a live ADMINISTRATOR ACL, and only then allow company_ready/resume.

runtime: All previously tested active LinkedIn connections lacked usable organization-admin capability.
Production setup v18 is preserved as the runtime base; only scoped OAuth creation/binding is added.
